input.summary: Right click on the icon now opens a popup with a Night light toggler, left click still toggles, and the popup closes on a second right click or when the compositor reports it closed. The change is confined to src/main.rs and matches the task: a persisted Settings struct next to 'enabled', no version bump (justified in its doc comment), and gamma untouched. cargo build is clean and cargo test passes (9 passed, 1 ignored live probe). Nothing must_fix; the main gap is that the new popup and settings behaviour has no tests.

findings.comment: The new popup state machine (ToggleSettings opening and closing, PopupClosed clearing `popup` only for the matching id) has no test, though the existing toggle and applied logic is tested by pure functions. Only the popup-id handling is new logic here.
findings.fix: Extract the popup-id transition into a small pure helper (for example `fn popup_closed(current: Option<Id>, closed: Id) -> Option<Id>`) and add unit tests: closing the matching id clears it, a different id leaves it, and closing when none is open is a no-op.

findings.comment: The settings popup is reachable only by right-clicking the pointer-only mouse_area, so keyboard and screen-reader users have no way to open it. The task asked for right click, so this is not a defect, but the popup's toggler has no accessible label beyond the settings::item title.
findings.fix: Note the limitation in the task's follow-up, or add a keyboard route (for example a shortcut or an accessible menu) in a later issue.

text:
I approved the change with no must_fix findings. It builds cleanly, and `cargo test` passes (9 passed, 1 ignored live probe).

- **What it does:** Right-clicking the icon opens a popup with a "Night light" on/off toggler. Left click still toggles. The popup closes on a second right click or when the compositor reports it closed. The change is confined to `src/main.rs`.
- **Task fit:** A `Settings` struct sits next to `enabled` in cosmic_config, with no version bump (the doc comment explains why). Gamma is untouched.
- **should_fix:** The new popup open/close and popup-id logic has no tests. I suggested pulling the id transition into a pure helper and unit-testing it.
- **suggestion:** Right-click is pointer-only, so keyboard and screen-reader users can't open the popup. That matches the task as written, so I flagged it as a note for a later issue rather than a fix now.

Under the review rules, the should_fix still goes back to the engineer before merge.
